stories.title: Alabama man wins $126,504 judgment over stormwater damage, but faces setback in latest appeal
stories.summary: William D. Carpenter triumphed in court, securing a judgment of $126,504.64 for stormwater damage in Alabama. However, challenges arose when he tried to enforce this judgment, prompting him to initiate a new lawsuit against both the homeowners' association and the homeowners. The Alabama Supreme Court dismissed his appeal over procedural technicalities, leaving the original claims of negligence and trespass unresolved as the case continues to unfold in the lower court.

stories.title: 'Goldy Dhillon a petty thief': Lawrence gang on gangster who threatened Amitabh Bachchan
stories.summary: The gang claimed Dhillon used to wash utensils at a restaurant in Germany for a living and said he lacked the wherewithal to target Bachchan or even his domestic staff.

stories.title: November’s sky has a full supermoon, the Leonid meteor shower, and Taurid showers, NASA says
stories.summary: November brings a captivating array of astronomical phenomena set to enchant stargazers everywhere. Mark your calendars for the Leonids meteor shower peaking on November 17 and 18 for a chance to catch stunning shooting stars. Don't miss the Taurids meteor showers illuminating the skies with bright fireballs around November 5 and 12. Additionally, on November 24, a spectacular supermoon will grace our night sky, appearing exceptionally large and luminous.

stories.title: George and Amal Clooney's foundation takes on injustice across 40 countries
After govt push, curbs on sexual post recommendations on Instagram
stories.summary: The changes apply to suggested posts from accounts users do not follow, including in Reels, and the main feed.

stories.title: UConn sued over bank naming deal at arena built with donor's $1 million gift
stories.summary: The daughters of Harry A. Gampel have filed a lawsuit against the University of Connecticut regarding naming rights for a building that they contend should bear their father's name, as per a 1989 agreement. This legal action comes after M&T Bank's recent renaming of the arena, prompting concerns about the erosion of their father's legacy.

stories.title: Bristol Wetland Plan: Bristol funds 200 projects; wetlands aim to curb flooding
stories.summary: Bristol is embarking on an innovative wetland restoration initiative, designed to enrich urban environments and promote biodiversity. This ambitious program aims to establish over 200 projects that enhance flood protection and improve accessibility for city dwellers. Notably, the introduction of floating gardens in September 2026 reflects the project's early achievements in rehabilitating urban habitats.

stories.title: Endangered rattlesnake gives birth to 9 young ones at Chicago zoo after a decade
Michigan woman loses appeal for larger share of marital wealth after 2018 $705,000 deal
stories.summary: In a recent court case, Cassandra Fameux from Michigan aimed to obtain a greater portion of her divorce settlement. She argued that a property agreement worth $705,000, signed during her guardianship, was unjust. However, the appeals court affirmed the earlier ruling, confirming the agreement's binding nature. The court dismissed her claims of undue pressure, leaving her with far less than the nearly $1 million she anticipated.

stories.title: 'World’s most wanted girlfriend’ Vera Dijkmans detained by ICE, DHS reveals why she faces deportation
Texas court blocks DNA test in dispute over handwritten will leaving estate to two beneficiaries
stories.summary: In Texas, a man’s handwritten will sparked controversy after naming two beneficiaries, which his cousin contested. This initiated a legal battle over the will's authenticity. The probate court called for DNA testing to verify the cousin's relationship but was overruled by a Texas appeals court, deeming the judge had overstepped. The legitimacy of the will remains under scrutiny as the probate court continues its review.

stories.title: Four motorcyclists crashed in Kentucky waste spill; court upholds $11m award
stories.summary: In an unusual incident on May 31, 2022, a truck carrying human waste spilled its load onto Interstate 24, leading to a dangerous motorcycle accident. High-speed riders lost control, resulting in severe injuries and lasting emotional trauma. After a trial in May 2025, a jury determined that the injured parties deserved $11 million in compensation.

stories.title: JetBlue flight from Puerto Rico to Florida hit by severe turbulence: 5 injured, what happened aboard Flight 1717?
Dua Lipa’s £6.75m London home still under renovation, with 2027 finish date
stories.summary: Dua Lipa has been deeply involved in the extensive renovation of her north London Victorian home, which she bought back in 2020. The project has hit snags due to planning disputes and environmental issues tied to the conservation area. Currently, intensive excavation is underway with hopes for several leisure and artistic areas. Unfortunately, the anticipated completion has now been delayed until July 2027, leaving the site buzzing with construction activity.

stories.title: Bela Lugosi's 'daytime coffin' Hollywood mansion sells for $6.75 million
stories.summary: Villa Dorada, a stunning Spanish Revival estate, hit the market for $7.5 million after half a century, captivating potential buyers with its storied past that includes Hollywood legends like Bela Lugosi and Jimmy Van Heusen. The property is rich in architectural details, featuring classic magnesite floors and intricately hand-carved doors. Nestled in the exclusive Outpost Estates neighborhood, the villa ultimately closed at $6.75 million

'Squandered nation’s best opportunity': Ex-ally Akhil Gogoi accuses Congress of weakening CJP agitation
'Who ransacked Halebidu?' BJP hits back at Rahul Gandhi over Hoysaleshwara Temple post
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party responded sharply to Rahul Gandhi's remarks regarding the emotional well-being of BJP and RSS supporters. They pressed him to confront the historical invasions that caused the ruin of Halebidu, demanding recognition of the invaders' identities. Assam's Chief Minister, Himanta Biswa Sarma, joined the dialogue, challenging Gandhi's portrayal of mortals as divine figures during a book launch where Gandhi shared familial experiences.

stories.title: Multiple NEET attempts, weightage to class 12 scores: States' suggestions to Nilekani panel
stories.summary: Multiple states are advocating for a system that enables students to attempt the NEET-UG exam more than once a year. Additional proposals suggest integrating Class 12 board exam results into the admissions framework. A high-powered task force, spearheaded by Nandan Nilekani, is currently evaluating feedback from various participants. The Centre has also extended the report submission deadline to January 2027, focusing on bolstering exam security and mitigating question paper leaks.
